function.name: navigate_to
function.description: Send the robot to a named location on campus (e.g., ECL 5, Drobotics Lab, Library, Cafeteria, VC Office, Administration).

location.description: The destination or room name to navigate to

function.name: navigate_and_deliver
function.description: Navigate to a named location and announce an item delivery on arrival.

location.description: The destination location or room name

item.description: The item or package being delivered

function.name: move_distance
function.description: Move the robot a specific distance in meters. Positive = forward, negative = backward.

meters.description: Distance in meters to move (positive = forward, negative = backward)

function.name: rotate
function.description: Rotate the robot by degrees in place. Positive = counterclockwise (left), negative = clockwise (right).

degrees.description: Angle in degrees to rotate (positive = counterclockwise / left, negative = clockwise / right)

function.name: stop
function.description: Cancel all robot motion immediately and brake in place.
